info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Knowledge Exchange API
info.description: The Knowledge Exchange API facilitates seamless access to knowledge assets within the banking sector. This endpoint allows users to retrieve specific knowledge resources identified by a unique parameter. Typical consumers include banking professionals and analysts seeking to enhance their decision-making with curated insights. By leveraging this API, organizations can foster collaboration and knowledge sharing, ultimately improving their overall service delivery.

get.summary: Retrieve knowledge exchange details by ID.
get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific knowledge exchange resource identified by its unique ID. This operation allows developers to access key attributes and metadata related to the knowledge exchange.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving knowledge asset data through the Knowledge Exchange API. This should contain the necessary parameters to filter or specify the data being requested.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource is returned.

GetKnowledgeExchangeByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the Knowledge Exchange API for the specified resource.

GetKnowledgeExchangeByIdResponse_200.title: Knowledge Exchange Response

knowledgeItemId.description: Unique identifier for the knowledge item.

topic.description: The topic or subject of the knowledge item.

authorId.description: Identifier of the author who created the knowledge item.

audience.description: Target audience for the knowledge item.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the knowledge item was published.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the knowledge item (e.g., draft, published, archived).

version.description: Version number of the knowledge item.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating the last update to the knowledge item.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the knowledge item.

GetKnowledgeExchangeByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response structure for knowledge exchange operations.

KnowledgeMetadata.title: Knowledge Metadata

responseId.description: Identifier for the response associated with the knowledge item.

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier for tracking the processing of the knowledge item.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the knowledge item was processed.

KnowledgeMetadata.description: Schema representing the metadata associated with a knowledge item.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer Authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Clients must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header of their requests to authenticate successfully.
